* 사용 쿼리

-- 쿼리작업은 Dbeaver에서 진행하여 쿼리 및 결과만 남김.

## Question 1


```
-- generate_series
with lag_n as (
select generate_series as lag_n from generate_series(0,30)
)
, gasoline_price as (
select
cast (strptime (cast(t1.part_dt as varchar) , '%Y%m%d') as date) as part_dt
, t2.lag_n
, cast (strptime (cast(t1.part_dt as varchar) , '%Y%m%d') as date) - cast (t2.lag_n as int) as lag_dt
, t1.prodcd
, t1.prodnm
, t1.price
from read_parquet('s3://petroleum-project/national_avg/price/*/*.parquet') t1
cross join lag_n t2
where 1=1  
and t1.part_dt >= '20080415'
and t1.part_dt <= '20260731'
and t1.PRODCD = 'B027' -- 일단은 휘발유 단일 가격만.
)
, crude_oil_price_join as (
select
t1.part_dt
, t1.lag_n
, t1.lag_dt
, t1.price
, t2.Dubai
, t2.Brent
, t2.WTI
from gasoline_price t1
left join read_parquet('s3://petroleum-project/crude_oil_price/*/*.parquet') t2
on t1.lag_dt = t2.part_dt
and t2.part_dt >= '2008-03-01'
and t2.part_dt <= '2026-07-31'
and t2.currency = 'USD'
)
select 
t1.lag_n
, count( distinct case when t1.Dubai is not null then  t1.part_dt end ) as Dubai_not_null_cnt
, count( distinct case when t1.Brent is not null then  t1.part_dt end ) as Brent_not_null_cnt
, count( distinct case when t1.WTI is not null then  t1.part_dt end ) as WTI_not_null_cnt
, corr( t1.price, t1.Dubai) as corr_Dubai
, corr( t1.price, t1.Brent) as corr_Brent
, corr( t1.price, t1.WTI) as corr_WTI
from crude_oil_price_join t1
group by 1
```
